title: 14 Day Kenya Birding Tour
rank_math_title: Kenya Birding Tour: 14 Wonderful Days, Forest to Desert
rank_math_desc: Kenya birding tour for 14 days: Nairobi NP, Lake Naivasha, Baringo, Kakamega, Lake Victoria, Nakuru, Mount Kenya and Samburu. Price on request.
post_content: This Kenya birding tour crosses the country from the Rift Valley lakes to the western rainforest, Mount Kenya and the dry north in 14 days.
overview:
This Kenya birding tour is a complete circuit of the country's best birding regions. In two weeks you visit papyrus swamps, soda lakes, rainforest, alpine moorland and semi-desert, so your bird list grows every single day.

The route is especially good in June and July, when the weather is dry, roads are easy and many resident birds are active. It works well at other times of year too.

Why choose this Kenya birding tour?

  • Nairobi National Park: Hartlaub's bustard and white-winged widowbird in sight of the city.
  • Kinangop Plateau: Sharpe's longclaw, an endemic of the highland grasslands.
  • Lake Baringo: Heuglin's courser, Jackson's hornbill and nightjars.
  • Kakamega Forest: three nights for great blue turaco, trogons and broadbills.
  • Mount Kenya and Samburu: moorland birds, then vulturine guineafowl and Somali specials.

Where you stay

We use comfortable lodges close to the birding sites: a Nairobi hotel, Lake Naivasha Country Club, Soi Lodge at Baringo, Rondo Retreat at Kakamega, a tented camp in Kisumu, Lake Nakuru Lodge, Naro Moru River Lodge, Samburu Sopa Lodge and Serena Mountain Lodge, or similar.

Best time for a Kenya birding tour

Birding is good all year. June to September is dry and comfortable. October to April brings migrant birds from Europe and Asia, and the short rains in November make the country green.

Read our Kakamega Forest guide, see the shorter 5 day Kenya birding safari, or browse all birding safaris. Nature Kenya keeps useful lists of Kenya's Important Bird Areas.

Price on request. The cost depends on your travel dates, group size, the season and the lodges you choose, so we prepare every quote personally rather than showing one fixed price.

Three nights in Kakamega, Kenya's only rainforest

faq.q: How many birds does the Kenya birding tour cover?
faq.a: Most groups record 450 to 550 species in 14 days, thanks to the wide range of habitats.
A Nairobi hotel, Lake Naivasha Country Club, Soi Lodge, Rondo Retreat, a Kisumu tented camp, Lake Nakuru Lodge, Naro Moru River Lodge, Samburu Sopa Lodge and Serena Mountain Lodge, or similar.

faq.q: Do I need to be fit?
faq.a: Moderate fitness helps. Forest walks at Kakamega and the drive up Mount Kenya to about 3,000 m are the most demanding parts.

faq.q: Is the Naivasha boat trip included?
faq.a: It is optional and can be added. It is a great way to see pelicans and water birds.

faq.q: Can I join if I am not an expert birder?
faq.a: Yes. Your guide helps everyone, and the mix of birds and big game makes it enjoyable for all.

faq.q: What is the best month for this tour?
faq.a: June and July are dry and pleasant. October to April adds migrant birds.
Yes. Samburu National Reserve is a popular, well-managed reserve and we travel with experienced guides.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Nairobi National Park
itinerary.content: Pick-up at your hotel for a full day in Nairobi National Park, with lunch at the park restaurant. Look for Hartlaub's bustard, Shelley's francolin and northern pied babbler. Overnight in Nairobi.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Limuru, Kinangop Plateau and Lake Naivasha
itinerary.content: Bird Limuru pond and Gatamaiyu Forest, then search the Kinangop grasslands for Sharpe's longclaw. Continue to Lake Naivasha Country Club.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Lake Naivasha to Lake Baringo
itinerary.content: Morning birding at Naivasha, with an optional boat trip, then drive north to Soi Lodge at Lake Baringo.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Lake Baringo
itinerary.content: A full day at Baringo's lake shore and cliffs for Heuglin's courser, Jackson's hornbill and owls.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Kerio Valley to Kakamega
itinerary.content: Drive west through the Kerio Valley with birding stops and arrive at Rondo Retreat in Kakamega Forest.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Kakamega Forest
itinerary.content: A full day on the forest trails for great blue turaco, bar-tailed trogon and African broadbill, plus colobus monkeys.

itinerary.label: Day 7
itinerary.title: Kakamega Forest
itinerary.content: Another day in the forest for flufftails, barbets and the many West African species found here.

itinerary.label: Day 8
itinerary.title: Kakamega to Lake Victoria
itinerary.content: Drive to Kisumu and bird the papyrus for papyrus gonolek, papyrus canary and blue-headed coucal. Overnight in a tented camp.

itinerary.label: Day 9
itinerary.title: Lake Victoria to Lake Nakuru
itinerary.content: Cross the Rift Valley to Lake Nakuru National Park for flamingos, pelicans and white rhinos. Overnight at Lake Nakuru Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 10
itinerary.title: Lake Nakuru to Mount Kenya
itinerary.content: Morning birding at Nakuru, then drive to Naro Moru River Lodge. Evening search for Mackinder's eagle-owl.

itinerary.label: Day 11
itinerary.title: Mount Kenya to Samburu
itinerary.content: Drive up Mount Kenya to around 3,000 m for highland birds, then head north to Samburu Sopa Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 12
itinerary.title: Samburu National Reserve
itinerary.content: A full day in Samburu for vulturine guineafowl, Somali bee-eater and Grevy's zebras.

itinerary.label: Day 13
itinerary.title: Samburu to Mount Kenya forest
itinerary.content: Drive back south with birding stops and stay at Serena Mountain Lodge in the forest.

itinerary.label: Day 14
itinerary.title: Thika and Nairobi
itinerary.content: Early birding from the lodge, then stops at Wajee and Thika for Hinde's babbler before returning to Nairobi.
